comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: Current2026programme controls: compulsory105+backgroundchoice3+restrictedRO2six+restrictedRO3twelve+thesis24=150,plusopen30. No formal major is specified. MathematicsA entry and first-listed laboratory RO2 are illustrative neutral choices; RO3 remains an aggregate pending supervising-chair preparation requirements. Programme requires two chair-preparing RO3 courses; module assumed-knowledge wording of at leastone does not waive that rule. Mandatory registration deadline and zero-credit safety/portfolio preserved. Numeric180doesnotcertifycompletepathway.

components.name: General Chemistry for the Life Sciences
The Philosophy and Ethics of Biology
Invertebrates, Algae, Fungi
components.note: Nine-credit organismal course. The zero-credit Biology Skills Portfolio and general, laboratory and fieldwork safety requirements are separate obligations.

components.name: Advanced Statistics
components.note: Six-credit compulsory Advanced Statistics remains included. The thesis module’s assumed-knowledge alternative of Ecological Methods does not remove this programme requirement.

components.name: Mathematics Applied: Introduction
components.note: Example for a student entering with VWO Mathematics A: Mathematics Applied: Introduction. Students with VWO Mathematics B take Statistics 1 instead.

components.name: Practical from Gene to Protein
components.note: Illustrative first-listed restricted option: Practical from Gene to Protein, for a cellular, plant or animal biology direction. Other directions use Molecular and Evolutionary Ecology. The final specialisation and thesis preparation remain unverified.

components.name: BSc Thesis Biology
components.note: Required 24-credit research project. Before starting, complete at least 102 prescribed credits including all first-year credits and pass the two restricted specialisation courses preparing for the supervising chair. Current chair-specific course allocation remains unverified. Registration at least one month before starting is mandatory; discuss a project about four months beforehand.

components.name: Restricted Specialisation Study
components.note: At least 12 credits must be chosen from the prescribed specialisation list. The final choices must prepare for the supervising thesis chair; this aggregate is not an instantiated course pair.

components.name: Open Electives or Minor
components.note: Thirty credits remain open for a minor, individual minor or elective courses.

audience.programmeDescription: Study life from cells and genes through organisms, evolution and ecosystems. Wageningen Biology combines biological theory with chemistry, physics, quantitative methods, laboratory and field research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The published credit structure is shown while the thesis-preparing course choices are verified. The prepared UCR comparisons remain withheld pending that clarification.
